name: timely
description: Turn conversation plans into Timely countdown links for iPhone, with App Clip support, Live Activities, and optional alarms.

interface.longDescription:
Keep your countdown going after you leave ChatGPT. Turn plans from your conversation into a countdown on your iPhone in just a few taps.

You don’t need the full Timely app installed: open the generated link with the Timely App Clip to view your countdown, start a supported Live Activity, and optionally enable an alarm. Already have Timely? Open the link to add the countdown to the app.

Follow a Live Activity on your iPhone’s Lock Screen and, on supported models, the Dynamic Island. It can also appear in the Smart Stack on a compatible paired Apple Watch.

Just say “Add that to Timely.” ChatGPT prepares the title, date or time, emoji, and colour. Review the details, then tap the link to continue in Timely or its App Clip. No Timely account connection is required.

Supports exact times and all-day dates. Live Activities and alarms require an exact time; Live Activities run during the final eight hours before the event. Availability depends on compatible devices, software, and permissions. Alarms are optional and enabled in Timely or the App Clip, not in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Create an iPhone countdown for my appointment.
Make a countdown I can follow after leaving ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies when the skill is useful for iPhone users, including events within eight hours and countdowns visible after leaving ChatGPT. Highlights App Clip access without installing the full app. Exact-time and all-day support and link encoding remain unchanged.
